terms.name: 3M SORA · 3-year lock-in
terms.terms: Published indicative Singapore home-loan schedule; confirm current availability and borrower eligibility with SBI. Building-under-construction properties qualify only for the three-year lock-in floating package. SORA spreads are not all-in rates; no benchmark fixing is collected. Fees, subsidies, income requirements and final approval must be checked with the bank. No publication/effective date is stated.
